temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia appears more withdrawn and down than usual at work. When Jose asks if everything is okay, she says it is just personal stuff and thanks him, but does not share details.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose believes Patricia is usually vibrant and is not aware of any specific problem troubling her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. He moves from no specific concern to suspecting Patricia is dealing with a personal problem she is not ready to discuss.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is troubled by something personal, appreciates his offer to listen, but has not disclosed details.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer non-pressuring support and remain available to listen if Patricia wants to talk.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose overhears Patricia on the phone worrying about bills and financial commitments. Patricia then confirms she has been overwhelmed with bills and says discussing financial planning or budgeting could be helpful.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia has a personal problem and may not have shared details; Jose does not yet know the specific cause.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Financial stress becomes a concrete concern, and Jose learns Patricia is receptive to help with budgeting or financial planning.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is financially stressed and overwhelmed, and she is open to discussing financial planning or budgeting with him.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Deepened concern and worry, along with empathy and some hopefulness because she accepted his offer.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer to discuss budgeting or financial planning with Patricia when she is ready, while continuing to support her.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia reassures Jose that he was not prying, says she is grateful for his offer, and tells him it is good to know she has someone to turn to.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia is financially stressed and accepted help, but Jose worries he may have overstepped his boundaries by bringing up financial planning.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. His worry about overstepping is resolved; he learns that Patricia welcomes his support and does not see it as intrusive.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia does not think he overstepped, values his support, and sees him as someone she can turn to, though he should still respect her privacy.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Worry and uncertainty giving way to relief, reassurance, and warmth.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue being a supportive friend, respect her privacy, and offer help without prying.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia gives a brief, positive update, plans a quiet weekend at home, and thanks Jose for being available but does not invite active help. Jose senses she appreciates his concern but prefers to handle her issues privately.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia values his support and does not think he overstepped, but Jose remains aware of the need to respect her privacy.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. He refines his belief: Patricia appreciates his concern but prefers to handle her issues privately and at her own pace rather than seeking active help now.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is managing things privately; his support is welcome but should be low-pressure and non-intrusive.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Respectful understanding, ongoing concern, and slight restraint.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Stay available and supportive without pushing, checking in casually rather than pressing for details.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During regular work check-ins, Patricia says she is busy but handling things, thanks Jose for checking in, and says it is great to have his support. Jose offers help with anything, even just grabbing a coffee.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia appreciates support but prefers privacy; Jose believes he should remain supportive without prying.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: No major new change; the event confirms that Patricia is handling her situation and welcomes his low-pressure support and check-ins.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is busy but managing, and she appreciates his supportive presence; regular low-pressure check-ins are appropriate.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue maintaining a supportive presence and regularly checking in at work, offering light practical help without overstepping.
